text:
Jordan (Stonebridge): hey @support team, seeing p99 jump to ~12s for most chat endpoints since ~08:10 UTC. started after the model tweak yesterday? requests failing with 504 or just huge latency. sample req ids: r_stb_7812, r_stb_7817, r_stb_7820. any quick mitigation we can try? :grimacing:
Maya (Support): thanks Jordan — sorry about that. can you confirm region and whether these are generation or embedding calls? also, any recent change on your side? :wave:
Jordan (Stonebridge): all generation (chat) to hosted endpoint in us-west-2. no changes from our release side. traffic relatively steady, but we do have a batch job that restarted around 07:50 which pings the API for long-context transcripts.
Maya (Support): copying oncall @Leo and infra @Priya to investigate tail. will collect traces.
Leo (Oncall Eng): looking at tenant metrics now. stonebridge shows p50 ~200ms p95 ~800ms p99 ~11.9s for chat.generate over last 40m. queue depth spiked to 220 requests around 08:12 UTC. I see many long-lived requests (>6s) with large context lengths. suspect queuing + a few slow workers.
Priya (SRE): checking autoscaler and instance churn. autoscaler didn't scale up quickly because requests were short-lived historically. but recent long-context jobs are keeping GPUs busy. I see one host with high KV cache evictions and GC churn — probably noisy neighbor effect.
Arjun (Platform): confirming kernel logs. a few workers hit large attention matrix sizes and degraded perf. also some model variant fallbacks occurred when we ran out of optimized kernels for the requested sequence length.
Maya (Support): Jordan — can you run a repro sample for us (one of the failing request payloads) and share request headers (tenant id and request id) so we can link traces?
Jordan (Stonebridge): sample attached (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Redwood-Tenant: stonebridge
Authorization: Bearer ***
{
  "model": "open-chatx-16k",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"<very long transcript ~12k tokens truncated>"}],
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```
Maya (Support): got it — thanks. Leo, can you grab the trace for r_stb_7817?
Leo (Oncall Eng): trace: https://observability.redwood.internal/traces/r_stb_7817 (private). waterfall shows long queue wait ~9.5s then compute ~2s. root cause: queue backlog + one slow worker handling very large context.
Priya (SRE): immediate mitigations I can apply now: 1) soft-per-tenant concurrency cap (limit to 12 concurrent requests) 2) emergency reservation: pin 1 GPU slot to stonebridge for 20m to drain backlog 3) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated transcripts if applicable. any preferences?
Jordan (Stonebridge): would prefer not to drop requests — reservation + cap sounds fine. caching would help long-term.
Arjun (Platform): I've got a quick patch to throttle extremely long-context requests by rejecting >13k token bodies with 429 and helpful error. can toggle via feature-flag. want to deploy it as a stopgap.
Maya (Support): summary of proposed immediate actions: - apply soft concurrency cap 12 - reserve 1 GPU for 30m - enable transient throttling for >13k tokens - notify customer and provide repro steps for lighter requests.
Priya (SRE): doing reservation now. command: ```rbctl reservation create --tenant stonebridge --gpus 1 --duration 30m --reason "emergency tail mitigation"```
ops-bot: reservation assigned: res-7291 to tenant stonebridge (1 x a100), expires in 30m.
Priya (SRE): soft concurrency cap applied via router policy. new header X-Redwood-Tenant-Concurrency set to 12 for stonebridge.
Arjun (Platform): toggled long-context throttle flag to ON for prod-router (rollout=100%). throttle will return 429 with helpful body: "request too large for shared pool, ask support for reservation".
Leo (Oncall Eng): after the reservation and cap p99 dropped from ~12s to ~1.1s in the next 6 minutes. queue depth back to ~15. dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/tenant/stonebridge
Jordan (Stonebridge): wow that improved a lot — thanks. can we make the reservation longer while we reorganize our batch job?
Maya (Support): follow-ups: - Priya to open ticket for longer short-term reservation + quota bump (owner: Priya) - Arjun to add a per-tenant long-context warning in API response (owner: Arjun) - Maya to send customer-facing note and suggested repro steps + docs (owner: Maya)
Priya (SRE): opened infra ticket INF-2041 for 72h reservation request and quota review. linking traces and logs. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-2041
Arjun (Platform): I'll follow up with a platform change to support per-tenant reserved capacity in the router policy (design doc in progress).
Maya (Support): Jordan, for smoother testing you can repro locally with this curl (will include tenant header):
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: stonebridge" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -d '{"model":"open-chatx-16k","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<long transcript here>"}],"max_tokens":512}'
```
Maya (Support): recommended long-term: - shard heavy batch jobs across time windows - use reserved capacity for nightly processing - enable KV/prefix caching or chunk transcripts before send
Jordan (Stonebridge): will throttle our internal batch and request the reservation. thanks everyone.
Leo (Oncall Eng): logging resolution in incident tracker. we'll keep an eye for 2 hours. adding watch: @Arjun @Priya @Maya
Maya (Support): closing note to customer drafted, sending now. :email:
Jordan (Stonebridge): thanks all, p99 holding at ~1.2s now. appreciate the quick responses. :tada:
